answer_b_extended_export_precheck.result: CANNOT change which decoder an AV1 source is routed to, CANNOT let an untrusted AV1 source reach in-process rav1d, does NOT skip the worker for Preview
evidence: Order in decode_video_track_with: `chosen` is computed by choose(route, video.codec) at video.rs:433-435 (CodecUnavailable when None) BEFORE the pre-check at :455-457 and consumed unchanged by `match chosen` at :458-482 (InProcess arm :460-466, External arm :467-481). The block is `if req.purpose == Purpose::Export { require_exportable_range(video.track, req)?; }`; the helper (isobmff.rs:2023-2039) takes only (track, req), receives no route and no trust, and its Ok value is discarded, so its only possible effect is an early Err. Error order before it is unchanged: CodecUnavailable (:433), video.unsupported (:436), content.refusal (:439), parse_av1c (:443). An untrusted AV1 source with no registered external decoder is therefore still CodecUnavailable (PLR-033 policy), never NotExact/OutOfRange/Incomplete.

What the pre-check refuses: require_exact_track_start (isobmff.rs:1953-1974: track.seek, then require_exact_start), requested_range (:1979-2001: zero count Unsupported; start + count-1 past track.presented -> OutOfRange, usize::try_from/checked_add so a count of u64::MAX is OutOfRange with no allocation), and for Export only distinct_media_samples != req.count -> Incomplete (:2029-2036). The one allocation, a Vec<u32> of wanted.len() entries (:2007), runs after the range check, so it is bounded by the already-indexed presented table (max_samples 4,000,000, 4 bytes each).

A Preview takes none of the new steps in video.rs, opens its session exactly as before and keeps its error order (a count past the end opens the session, then OutOfRange from deliver_packets). answer_c_delivery_complete_and_delivery_.result: No effect on AV1 routing, trust or the declared-size refusal
evidence: model.rs:478-489 delivery_complete(req, delivered): equal -> Ok(true); otherwise Err(Incomplete{requested, delivered}) for Purpose::Export, Ok(false) for Preview. model.rs:493-499 delivery_disposition: pure mapping (Partial when incomplete, else Exact/Approximate from the start). Neither takes or reads a route, trust, size or decoder; both are pub(crate) and called only from receipt construction: isobmff.rs:2139/2156 (deliver_packets), isobmff/pcm.rs:544/562, wav.rs:378/395, y4m.rs:372/395, mxf/provider.rs:261/273.

On the video/AV1 path the only call is deliver_packets (video.rs:504-513). `delivered` there counts non-preroll slots visited (isobmff.rs:2133-2135), one per distinct media sample of `wanted`; for Export the pre-check has already established distinct == count, so delivery_complete cannot return Err there after a passing pre-check. For Preview it returns Ok(false) for a repeating range (Partial); video.rs then overwrites actual.units with the pictures delivered and sets Partial/complete false on a picture shortfall (:520-531), unchanged.

Declared-size refusal ordering is unchanged: Forward::accept raises DecoderFault::Protocol (video.rs:331-335) inside sink.accept during the packet loop, or in session.finish (:514-516) which runs after deliver_packets returns; the new delivery_complete call sits after the loop (isobmff.rs:2137-2139) and cannot pre-empt a refusal raised inside the loop; a picture refused at finish() is still refused because deliver_packets returns Ok for a complete delivery. packed_len/max_chunk_bytes check (:346-350) precedes the copy (:351-354) as before.

deliver_packets slots change (isobmff.rs:2082 get_or_insert: a media sample presented more than once is delivered at its FIRST presented entry instead of the last) affects only which pts tags a re-presented sample gets; the video route tags pictures by chunk.index (the sample index), not by pts (video.rs:323), so picture matching and the declared-size check are unaffected.

Other new error paths, none reachable for AV1 routing: mxf/provider.rs temporal-offset Corrupt predates this range; per-track elst refusal now also sets pcm.window to Err(Unsupported) (isobmff.rs:1660-1666) and makes read_timecode_start return Unsupported for a refused named/tmcd track (timecode.rs:74, :84); a refused video track is still refused by select_track (isobmff.rs:1717) and seek/probe before choose() or any session. DESCRIPTOR/doc text only otherwise.
